newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA - Durres - Four vessels in port, all discharging, of which 3 bagged wheat, 1 kerosene. 2 Vessels in roads awaiting berths of which 1 to discharge steel constructions, 1 to discharge general cargo.

BULGARIA, Aug 19-25 - Varna, Varna east, Varna west, Balchik, Teps - 34 Vessels operating of which 20 loading (3 soda, 1 glass, 3 fertiliser, 1 wood, 1 water bottles, 3 clinker, 1 cigarettes, 2 cement, 2 SAS, 1 cognac, 1 craft paper, 1 TSP/DCP). 5 Discharging (2 coal, 1 rice, 1 wheat, 1 trucks). 9 Discharging/loading (1 phosphorite/NTP, 2 containers/trucks, 6 containers). 14 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load (2 fertiliser, 1 iron plates, 1 scrap, 1 cellulose). 2 To discharge (1 coal, 1 sugar), 7 cargo not nominated. Conditions Aug 26 - No labour problems reported.

Varna, Varna east - 6 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge. Varna west - 8 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load. Varna Lesport - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Bourgas, Bourgas east - 14 Vessels due with delays expected. 9 Vessels loading at berth. 2 Discharging at berth, 16 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge. 8 Vessels under repair/dry-docked. Bourgas west - 1 Vessel discharging at berth. Tanker berth - 1 Vessel loading at berth.

CROATIA, Aug 26 - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth, 2 berthed and inoperative. 7 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 anchored, 3 due with delays expected. Pula, Rasa, Zadar, Sibenik, Split, Ploce, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Aug 27 - Limassol - Ten vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, none waiting. 16 Vessels due by 28/8 of which 9 containers, 1 conventional vessel, 6 passenger vessels. No delays expected. Larnaca - No vessels in port, none due.

ESTONIA, Aug 27 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 2 Liner vessels in port, 4 vessels due. Kopli - 4 Vessels due. Muuga - 3 Black oil vessels loading at berth, 2 vessels discharging at berth of which 1 petrol, 1 grain, 3 liner vessels of which 1 passenger, 2 ferries. Parnu - Two timber vessels loading at berth, 2 vessels due.

ITALY, Aug 27 - Naples - One bulk carrier ETB 27/8. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa - Commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 27 Berthed, 2 dry-docked. Multedo - oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 berthed. Savona, Vado Ligure, Leghorn, Gaeta, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara, Trieste - No vessels in roads, no delays. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 7 berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads, no delays. Naples - One vessel in roads, no delays. Augusta - oil harbour - 3 vessels in roads, 5 berthed. Syracuse - oil harbour - 5 Vessels in roads, none berthed. Milazzo - oil harbour - No vessels in roads, 3 berthed. Sarroch - No vessels in roads, 7 berthed, no delays. Taranto - No vessels in roads. Ravenna - Six vessels in roads, no delays. Venice - Six vessels in roads, no delays.

LATVIA, Aug 26 - No strikes. Riga - 16 Vessels in port, all operating, of which 5 timber loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 fertiliser loaders, 3 tanker loaders, 2 steel loaders, 1 scrap metal loader, 2 frozen food dischargers. No vessels waiting, no delays, 15 due. Ventspils - Two vessels in port, both operating, of which 1 steel loader, 1 steel billets/wire rope loader. No vessels waiting, no delays, 5 due. Liepaja - Five vessels in port, all operating, none waiting, no delays, none due.

LITHUANIA, Aug 26 - Klaipeda - 13 Vessels operating of which 8 loading (1 metal, 1 scrap, 2 fertiliser, 1 oil, 1 peat/moss, 1 cement, 1 potash), 3 discharging (1 fish, 1 sugar, 1 by-products). No vessels in roads, 28 due.

POLAND, Aug 27 - Szczecin - 45 Vessels loading at berth, 30 discharging. 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting to discharge, 9 under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders. 80 Vessels due with delays expected. Gdynia - 11 Vessels operating of which 2 general cargo loading at berth. 4 Vessels discharging (1 ore, 3 general cargo). 5 Under repair dry-docked, 20 vessels due. Gdansk - 19 Operating of which 11 loading at berth (3 coal, 3 bulkers, 5 general cargo), 3 discharging (1 ore, 2 bulkers). 5 Under repair/dry-docked, 21 due.

PORTUGAL, Aug 27 - Setubal - Three vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging. 2 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 15 due of which 8 to discharge, 6 to load, 1 for repairs. Leixoes - Eight vessels operating of which 5 general cargo, 3 containers. No vessels waiting. Vacant places. 3 Piers with cranes.

RUSSIA, Aug 26 - Baltic ports - St. Petersburg - 22 Vessels operating of which 16 loading (6 fertiliser, 4 non-ferrous metal, 3 steel, 1 containers, 2 coal), 6 discharging (2 butter, 2 frozen chicken, 1 sugar, 1 malt). 10 Vessels awaiting operations, 7 due. Kaliningrad - No strikes. Three vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 scrap metal loader, 1 birch loader, 1 fertiliser loader, no vessels waiting, no delays, 1 vessel due. Vyborg - One vessel in port operating, none waiting, no delays, 5 vessels due.

Far Eastern ports, Aug 27 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - 22 Vessels in port of which 2 passenger, 8 loading (7 metal, 1 timber), 2 loading/discharging containers, 10 waiting. Nakhodka - 19 Vessels in port of which 11 loading (1 general cargo, 7 metal, 3 timber), 8 waiting. Vostochny - Eight vessels in port of which 4 loading (2 coal, 1 timber, 1 metal), 2 loading/discharging containers, 2 waiting. Posyet - One vessel loading metal. Khasan - No vessels.

Black Sea - Novorossiysk, Aug 26 - 13 Vessels in port operating of which 9 loading (1 scrap, 4 steel, 1 copper cathodes, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 paper, 1 barley). 4 Discharging (1 cement, 2 rice, 1 various). 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 copper cathodes, 1 tin plate, 1 seeds), 2 to discharge (1 rice, 1 barytes). 17 vessels due of which 11 to load (2 scrap, 6 steel, 1 fertiliser, 1 general cargo, 1 other,). 6 to discharge (2 sugar, 2 zinc concentrates, 1 general cargo, 1 containers). Oil terminal, Aug 27 - 1 Tanker berthed loading crude oil, 4 in roads of which 3 to load crude, 1 diesel oil. 10 Tankers due of which 8 to load crude, 1 diesel oil, 1 fuel oil.

White Sea - Archangel, Aug 27 - No strikes/lock outs. Twelve vessels in port of which 5 loading timber, 1 embarking passengers, 3 discharging gravel, 3 under repair. 8 Vessels due, all to load, of which 6 oil products, 2 timber. Congestion expected at the Neftebaza berths for tankers August 28-31. Northern basin, Murmansk - Aug 27 - Two vessels operating of which 1 apatite, 1 cabotage. 1 Apatite loader waiting, 5 Vessels due during the week of which 3 loaders (2 apatite, 1 npk), 2 alumina dischargers.

SLOVENIA, Aug 26 - Koper - Four vessels berthed of which 1 container vessel loading/discharging, 1 bulk carrier discharging. 2 Vessels loading (1 bulk carrier, 1 livestock). 16 Due over next 2 days of which 5 containers (loading/discharging) 3 general cargo, 4 bulk carriers (all to load), 2 bulk carriers, 2 reefers (all to discharge). No delays expected.

SPAIN, Aug 26 - Aviles - No delays/congestion/strikes. Five vessels operating of which 4 discharging (1 fuel oil, 1 iron ore, 1 steel products, 1 blender), 1 loading steel products. Gijon - No delays/congestion/strikes. Six operating of which discharging (2 coal, 1 cement, 1 petroleum products), 2 loading (1 steel products, 1 pieces). Sagunto - 18 Vessels operating of which 11 discharging (7 steel products, 1 logs/timber, 1 liquid ammonia, 1 perishable goods, 1 citrus). 4 Loading (1 fertiliser, 1 machinery, 2 general cargo). 3 Ro/ros loading/discharging. No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf. No berthing delays. Aug 27 - Pasajes - 16 vessels in port of which 10 discharging (8 scrap, 1 granite, 1 wood-pulp), 4 loading steel, 1 discharging/loading cars, 1 under repair. No delays. Cadiz - 17 Operating of which 4 ro/ros, 3 sugar. 4 Under repair. No delays.
